bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Dying overlord, arrogant to the last syllable
bosses.text: Impossible. The vault was mine. Take the override rail. It still remembers my hand.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Machine warden shutting down, flat and final
bosses.text: Core integrity zero. Forge power is... cold. Take the arc cannon. Do not touch the coils.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.text: Specimen containment failed. Take the corrosive carbine. The green will outlive us both.
